settings.text: What is Blue Boost? +

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Blue Boost is a pharmaceutical-grade met
settings.text: Blue Boost is a pharmaceutical-grade methylene blue capsule designed to support mental clarity, mitochondrial energy, and long-term brain health. Each capsule delivers 12mg of lab-tested methylene blue with added Vitamin C Ester for enhanced absorption.

settings.repere: Bouton · How should I take it? +
settings.text: How should I take it? +

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Start with 1 capsule in the morning to a
settings.text: Start with 1 capsule in the morning to assess your tolerance. Take with or without food. Avoid taking late in the day as some users report increased alertness and energy.

settings.repere: Bouton · Will it turn my urine blue? +
settings.text: Will it turn my urine blue? +

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Yes, this is completely normal. Methylen
settings.text: Yes, this is completely normal. Methylene blue is excreted through urine and may temporarily cause a blue or greenish tint. It's a sign the compound is active in your system and is entirely harmless.

settings.repere: Bouton · Is this tested by third parties? +
settings.text: Is this tested by third parties? +

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Yes. Blue Boost is tested by an independ
settings.text: Yes. Blue Boost is tested by an independent third-party lab for methylene blue content, heavy metals, and microbial contamination. Lab reports are published on our Third-Party Tests page.

settings.repere: Bouton · Can I take it with other supplements? +
settings.text: Can I take it with other supplements? +

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Yes. Blue Boost pairs well with most dai
settings.text: Yes. Blue Boost pairs well with most daily supplements. However, avoid combining with SSRIs, SNRIs, or MAOIs, and always consult your healthcare provider if you are on any prescription medication.

settings.repere: Bouton · Where is Blue Boost made? +
settings.text: Where is Blue Boost made? +

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Blue Boost is manufactured in the USA in
settings.text: Blue Boost is manufactured in the USA in an NSF- and GMP-certified facility. We use pharmaceutical-grade methylene blue (USP specification) with no artificial dyes, fillers, or proprietary blends.
